title: Celebrated at birth, pushed into sex work

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: Her elder daughter works with an NGO and is preparing to write the police exam, while her younger daughter is preparing for medical entrance tests in Indore.

social_cohesion_impact.evidence: In Sagargram, a group of mostly college-going youth formed a committee about four years ago. Within a year, they were able to stop sex work and liquor inside their village.

justice_rights_impact.evidence: Saniya says she encouraged a friend, who was being pressured by her family to get into sex work, to fight back. 'Her parents came to my house to complain to my parents, but my parents took my side. My friend fought with her parents, and they eventually relented. She is now continuing her studies.'
